verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Autumn serves an llms.txt at docs.useautumn.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It indexes markdown versions of the docs, and the docs pages themselves are served as .md URLs, which suits agent ingestion. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs (e.g., an llms-full.txt or guidance on pointing agents at them), and independent corroboration of agents using them in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
